title: A merge stage that will not parse leaves a thread's file a side to take, dropping the other side's work packages
body:
`Facade::thread_both_sides_added_packages_to` (facade.rs, about :14455) returns `Ok(None)` when a conflicted thread file's stage will not parse as JSON or decode as a thread, so the path becomes a take-a-side step. Taking a side there drops the other side's work packages, which is issue 0555's outcome. A missing stage is rightly None.

Expected: a stage that will not parse or decode is refused with a typed error naming the path and the stage, and nothing is written.

Found by ST0096's close-time catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H2-critic-rust-wp02-0709-20261122). Fixed under hv decision 86 for 3.5.1, dc's unit d86d.
